context: M17 o4. Nick's penthouse office. Delphine across the desk. Two bankers, one table.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Miss Moore. My agent says you're persistent. My agent is right.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Twenty women. Five dollars a week. Seven years. Not one default.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Seven years without a default. My bank should hire you.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Your bank wouldn't let me in the door, Mr. Varelas. Neither would your agent.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Then we have something in common. My bank won't let me in the door either.
